name: interfering-bodies
why: Two bodies drawn through each other are reported, not refused: the boss's lower 5 mm lies inside the plate, so the pair is `interfering` by π·25·5 = 392.699 mm³ with no clearance to report, while each body alone is intact. The interference is exact (BRepGProp on the common solid) and holds at the corpus tolerance; the boss's own 1570.796 mm³ is read off its 0.01 mm mesh, which polygonises a Ø10 cylinder 0.13% short, hence the wider volume tolerance. The part-level bodies and voids are the count of two closed mesh shells that cross each other, recorded as measured and not to be read as the part's piece count — between_bodies is.
